proxy_documentation.true_volume: OKX candle volume used when present; else ATR pulse proxy
proxy_documentation.order_flow_proxy: close location in bar range + body ratio (aggressive buy/sell proxy)
proxy_documentation.liquidity_sweep_proxy: pierce prev_low20/prev_high20 then close back through level + wick dominance
proxy_documentation.vwap_proxy: cum_vwap from typical_price=(h+l+c)/3 weighted by volume (or range if vol missing); vwap_dist_proxy=(close-vwap)/vwap
proxy_documentation.auction_failure: break prev_high20/prev_low20 then close back inside + opposing wick ≥ threshold
proxy_documentation.funding_behaviour: OKX public funding-rate-history fetched when network allows; funding_z_proxy / funding_sign features injected if series alignable; else documented as unavailable for bar-level backtest
proxy_documentation.oi_behaviour: OKX open-interest snapshot + history if fetchable; oi_chg_proxy; else document gap
